Port html-game-v2's layered explosion look into effect-renderer: fireball flash, warm shell rays, shockwave ground-ring, ballistic embers, gravity+bounce shrapnel streaks, and dark lingering smoke — all regenerated deterministically per-frame from one wire object (no extra replication). Fix brain-dead muzzle FX + explosion ground assumptions: muzzle flash now a LOCAL first-person effect at the real viewmodel muzzle anchor (getMuzzleWorldPosition via an empty pinned to the baked 'muzzle' anchor) instead of a huge replicated sprite at the camera eye that blinded the shooter; shrunk flash/smoke. Explosion now uses real injected terrainHeight for the ground (shockwave ring gated to near-ground hits; embers/shrapnel skid on the true terrain) instead of assuming ground==blast Y, which floated the ring/bounce plane for tree/wall/creature/airburst hits.

Shoot-house v2 redesign (bigger + more varied per a 6-agent brainstorm): default footprint 88x150 (was 64x100), asymmetric left/right generated from independent sub-seeds (opts.symmetric restores mirror), size/difficulty presets (wired to ?size=/?difficulty=), entry vestibule with spawn, 3-6 rooms/side with non-uniform depths, six room types (open/cover/pillars/shelving/crates/tables) + L-return cover, staggered spine doorways, chest-high murder-hole windows, mezzanines in deep open rooms, up to two staircases, per-room colored/dim point lights, and emissive exit/hazard signage. Rewrote the Node test suite (552 checks incl. flood-fill reachability, replacing the mirror-symmetry invariant).

Fix wall-bullet collision: shots were resolved against the bilinear terrain heightfield, which stores wall-top height per column and ramps it into adjacent floor cells — spawning invisible shot-blockers ~0.6-1m beside every wall and inside doorways (impacts off the visible wall face; hard to shoot through doorways). Added mapCollider.raycast(origin,dir,maxDist) BVH occluder; resolveHitscan now takes an occluder; resolveWorldShot uses it (hitscan+projectiles) and skips the heightfield march when NO_ENVIRONMENT. Walls/barricades/pillars now stop bullets on their real faces and doorways pass cleanly; cover is ballistic.

Add Node harness verifying the wall-bullet fix without a GPU (ray-vs-box == map-BVH nearest hit): asserts spine doorways clear at y=0.5-2.0 and wall shots land on the real face within T/2 across 5 seeds x 2 sides; reproduces the old heightfield's off-face aliased blocker for contrast.

Fix port-creature wander drifting to world origin: added pure self-relative pickRoamTarget (anti-backtrack cone + optional world bounds, unit-tested) in creature-interaction.js, routed all roamTarget picks through it in port-creature-system.js, and deleted the uncapped origin-anchored boundary force (ARENA_R/SOFT_EDGE/BOUNDARY_GAIN); wired a new getWorldBounds callback through the bridge so authored maps still contain roam while infinite terrain roams freely; removed the leftover window.__pc debug hook.

Make the procedural night sky vary: build() previously seeded its three deterministic generators (stars/Milky Way/bodies) from hardcoded constants, so every load rendered the identical sky. Now all three derive from one palette.seed via XOR salts; added skyRef.setSeed(n) (rebuilds, safe as a discrete call) and persisted starCount/milkyWayIntensity into the palette so a seed rebuild keeps live-adjusted state. SKY_PARAMS.seed is randomized per load and exposed as a Sky-panel number field + Reroll button. sky-field.js untouched (Node tests unaffected).

Phase 2: wire the pure creature-activity.js FSM into port-creature-system.js -- ROLE_WILD creatures now autonomously wander/sleep/hunt/socialize/graze (updateActivity pass, new hunt steering branch, updateCombat huntTarget hookup, wake-on-damage, restPose settle in the render crouch), gated so ambient wildlife always runs it and other wild creatures only under the default wander Mode; pets/hostiles/other Modes unchanged.

Fix sky-reroll 'buffer used in submit while destroyed' freeze: setSeed's rebuild() was the first runtime caller of disposeTree, which called geometry.dispose() on the old sun/moon/celestial-body THREE.Sprites — but all Sprites share one module-level QuadGeometry, so it destroyed the buffer the newly-built sprites still draw from. Freeze only appeared looking up (sprites are frustumCulled). disposeTree now skips geometry disposal for sprites (!o.isSprite).

Expose more sky sliders. Live (uniform/draw-range, no rebuild): star brightness (setStarOpacity) + star color picker (setStarColor). Regeneration (edit SKY_PARAMS, committed by an Apply button / Reroll via setPalette, not live-dragged): planet count + moon count (palette count overrides that still consume their RNG draw), planet/moon size (bodyScale multiplier), planet texture resolution (resScale threaded into celestial-bodies painter canvas edge, clamped 96-2048), and Milky Way density (band points per star). Regeneration rows are slider + number field. Added sky-field test coverage for the count/scale/density overrides. Star point size stays unexposed (WebGPU Points are 1px).
Double default cloud extent (layer1 2000->4000, layer2 4000->8000) and raise both Extent slider maxes to 16000 to push the visible plane edge out; world-space noise sampling means no stretching.

Phase 0 of the internetcore redesign: turn the single Shoot House start-screen card into a type dropdown (SHOOTHOUSE_TYPES) and add a demo room. New shoot-house-style.js is the single source of aesthetic truth (PALETTE + per-material PBR MATERIALS); generateDemoRoom() emits one roofless room showcasing deck floor + emissive grid, neon wall/portal/cover trim, one cover sample, one placard, neon light rig (no tactical layout vocab yet). Builder dispatches on type and reads MATERIALS; viewer threads shoot-house-<type> mapKey and applies bloom/tone defaults under NO_ENVIRONMENT. 26-check Node test added; existing layout+collision tests still green.

Phase 3 of wild-behavior overhaul: per-creature personality. creature-activity.js adds TEMPERAMENTS (6 archetypes: balanced/predator/sleepy/social/grazer/restless) + sampleTemperament(rand,jitter) returning {name,weights} with +/-15% per-weight jitter. variedCreatureConfig seeds config.temperament from its RNG; Creature ctor stores this.temperament/temperamentName; updateActivity passes weights:this.temperament to chooseActivity so activity odds now vary by creature. temperament round-trips through creatureToConfig/creatureToSharedConfig (survives resets/export/MP). Uniform mode stays balanced by design. New sampleTemperament + predator-vs-sleepy bias tests green.

Stage 1 of an in-viewer creature stats/analysis UI. Expose get selected() on system API. New Stats tab (environment-ui tabDefs) built by new creature-stats.js: live readout of selected creature, in-memory+localStorage(pcw:creatureStatsDb) database via Add-selected/Capture-all, JSON/CSV export, Canvas2D bar+histogram charts. Pure data-shaping (extractFeatures/toCsv/histogram) exported + Node-tested (test-creature-stats.mjs, 20 checks green). PCA/ordination + richer metrics deferred to Stage 2. Browser QA of live wiring pending.

Demo-room look tuning (batched from live iteration): grid emissiveIntensity kept 2.6, neon lowered to 1.3; instead dialed the NO_ENVIRONMENT bloom way down (strength/radius 0.05, threshold 1.85, smooth 0.085) so the neon-heavy look reads without blowing out. Also set FPS default walk speed (fp.speedStand) 2.05->4.0 (run stays walk*2.05 ~=8.2).

Phase 2 of the internetcore redesign: the CQB cover vocabulary. New shoot-house-pieces.js exports 5 pure composable pieces (holoBarrier, lightPillar, halfWallBaffle, holoPlatform, portalDoor + PIECES registry), each returning shoot-house-style.js-keyed boxes with a dark body + emissive accent and an `accent` override for phase-3 two-tone zoning; decoupled from the layout module (pre-derived body-scale defaults) to avoid an import cycle. Demo room now doubles as the vocabulary showcase (one of each piece, spaced to read individually) and uses portalDoor for its front frame. Collision consumes all boxes regardless of kind, so pieces are solid+ballistic automatically. New 22-check pieces test; demo test extended to 30 (asserts baffle/pillar/platform/ramp). Added style+pieces nodes/edges to code-map (style module was missing since phase 0).

Stats-tab database rows are now clickable to toggle a creature's selection box. Expose select(creature|null) on the port-creature-system API (wraps selectCreature). In creature-stats.js: db rows carry data-id, a read-only liveById reverse-lookup maps a row to its still-live creature, clicking toggles sys.select (same amber BoxHelper path as a 3D-view click); selected row highlighted amber, despawned-creature rows dimmed/inert; highlight re-syncs each readout tick so 3D-view selections light the row too.
Double default cloud extent again (layer1 4000->8000, layer2 8000->16000), slider maxes to 32000, to push the visible plane edge further out.
Disable scene fog on cloud material (mat.fog=false); worldFog.far is pinned to terrain size so fog was clamping clouds to the map edge regardless of extent - clouds have their own horizon fade.
Fix setExtent one-axis bug: mesh is rotated flat so plane spans local X/Y; scale.set(s,s,1) not (s,1,s) which only grew world X and left world Z pinned at 2000.

Phase 3 of the internetcore redesign: room archetypes. New shoot-house-rooms.js exports ROOM_ARCHETYPES (gauntlet/atrium/crossfire/overwatch/open) + buildRoomContent(id,ctx) composing phase-2 pieces into designed, entry-relative layouts; seed varies parameters, never whether cover exists (replaces v2 random scatter). Builder dispatches type 'rooms'. rooms.js imports pieces only (no cycle). New 32-check rooms test; demo/pieces/layout/collision suites still green.

Stage 2 of the creature stats UI. Instrument richer discarded-in-physicsStep diagnostics: dragAvg (planted-foot overextension = limb-drag), scanFailPct, stuckPct (wants&&!canMove), comOutsidePct (COM vs support polygon via new comInside/haveSupport capture), wobbleDeg (EMA var of pitch/roll). summary: Combat bot polish pass from playtesting feedback: fixed a facing bug where the wire-pose quaternion was pi off from the bots own yaw/aim/fire convention so their mesh faced backwards; added pairwise bot/player capsule collision (pushBotsApart) so bots stop phasing into each other and the player; gave GhostRenderers capsule-ghost path a fall-over death pose driven by an alive flag; made respawn (on/off), weapon type (hitscan select), and health/speed/sight-range/seek-tenacity panel-tunable; and replaced the terrain wander fallback with an on-demand local A* window (requestBotPath), since a static full-map bake is infeasible at the 1200-4000m scale of the authored terrain maps.

Added scroll-wheel zoom for the third-person chase cam (lbCamDist state clamped 1.8-9 replacing the hardcoded 3.6 pull-back distance) so WASD-plus-zoom 3rd-person controls work end to end; WASD/mouse-look already worked in third-person since they share the FPS movement pipeline.

Second combat-bot polish pass: GhostRenderer death fall now animates smoothly over 450ms (tick()-driven lerp/slerp) instead of snapping; added a host-local player immortality toggle gating applyHitDamage/applyExplosionBlast; bots now react to being shot or shot-at by turning to face and advance on the threat (reusing the SEEK/tenacity machinery via a new alertBotsToShot near-miss check) and propagate that awareness to nearby squadmates within 15m; and the local player is only perceivable/hittable by bots while actually first-person (fpsMode without third-person body view), fixing a bug where the player could still be shot while in third-person even though they could not see their own body.
Added WASD ground-plane panning to the orbit/overhead camera mode (updateOrbitPan
column5: shift runs) since it previously only supported drag-rotate and scroll-zoom.

summary: Fixed orbit-to-FPS re-entry teleporting the player back to a stale prior position instead of the spot the orbit camera had drag/WASD-panned to; enterFPS now snaps playerCollider to the current orbit target x/z (except on the very first entry or when resuming from a cursor-free pause).
Fixed third-person shooting being silently dropped: fireGunFromCamera sent camera.position (chase-cam pulled back up to lbCamDist behind the body) as the shot origin
column5: which validateShot MAX_ORIGIN_DRIFT anti-cheat check in combat.js rejected with no client-visible error; now uses playerCollider.end when localBodyThird is true.

summary: Third combat-bot polish pass: bots no longer have effectively unlimited ammo (reloadAmmo used to run instantly on an empty mag; now gated behind a 1800ms BOT_RELOAD_MS timer during which the bot keeps aiming but cannot fire); botHasLineOfSight and the terrain nav walkability test now account for trees/rocks (trunkIndex/dressingIndexRef), reusing the same obstacle-column occlusion pipeline real shots resolve against, so bots can no longer see or path through forest/rocks; and added Notice time and Accuracy sliders so a freshly-spotted target has a reaction-delay grace period before a bot is allowed to fire, and fired shots get random spread at low accuracy instead of always landing exactly on the bots true aim.

Code-review pass on the third ammo/LOS/notice polish pass: botHasLineOfSight's raycast (reuses resolveHitscan+obstacleColumnsAlongRay) was running every frame per bot per candidate, previously only run when a shot was actually fired; pickBotTarget now splits into a cheap always-fresh nearest-candidate pass and a per-bot-throttled (120ms, BOT_LOS_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS) raycast. Also fixed the notice-time clock resetting on a single-frame LOS flicker (rec.targetAcquiredAt nulled instantly on any occlusion) by adding a 400ms grace window (BOT_NOTICE_GRACE_MS, rec.lastVisibleAt) before the clock actually resets.

Design-only spec for squads (5+ bots, leader-follow movement, attack/retreat orders), outposts (2-3 squads + outpost leader, ammo stockpile, capturable flag), and a real ammo economy (death drops, leader-called parachute drop crates, squad ammo pool) to replace bots' currently-nonexistent ammo refill path -- not implemented yet, requested as a follow-up to the ammo-exhaustion issue found in code review.

Added an Esc pause menu (Restart Game / Main Menu) usable from FPS, third-person, and orbit; Escape no longer drops FPS into orbit/spectator on its own (only F does, via a new intentionalOrbitExit flag distinguishing F's deliberate pointer-lock release from Escape/alt-tab/focus-loss in the pointerlockchange listener). Both buttons reload the page (simplest clean reset given the single long-lived module script + live multiplayer socket + WebGPU context); Restart first stashes the current {mapKey,mpRole,roomCode,mpWorldMode,presetName} in sessionStorage so start-screen.js's showStartScreen(resumeConfig) skips the role/map picker and silently re-enters the same game, while Main Menu clears that and shows the normal picker.

Refined the squad/outpost spec's command-hierarchy section: replaced the flat 50/50 coin-flip decisions (squad leader's loss-triggered retreat, outpost leader overruling a squad leader, outpost leader commanding other squads when one is lost/retreats) with a single per-bot temperament trait (0-1 aggression) that weights all three rolls, added edge-trigger latching so decisions fire once per event instead of re-rolling every tick, and added a retreat speed multiplier for bots following a retreat order.

Extended the squad/outpost spec with a first aid kit economy (bots spawn with 1, use it via an interruptible run-then-channel heal state that finally implements the FSM's long-deferred hp-gated retreat state, drop it on death alongside ammo via a supply_drop entity generalized from ammo_drop, outposts stock a medkitStockpile) and outpost/squad map placement (outposts placed uniformly at random subject to walkability spacing, squads placed via a distance-weighted accept/reject gradient biased toward but not limited to outpost proximity, mirroring plants-placement.js's existing clustering accept/reject pattern).

Implemented Phase 1 of the squad/outpost spec via two parallel Sonnet agents against a fixed contract: squad-activity.js (pure temperament roll, edge-triggered loss-retreat decision, formation geometry, Node-tested) plus environment-viewer.html wiring (Squad record/Map, batch spawn into squads, leader-follow formation movement, retreat speed multiplier, leader succession, a Squads and Outposts panel section). No ammo/medkits/outposts yet (Phases 2-4). Full test-*.mjs suite (77 files) and node --check both verified clean by the orchestrator after integration; interactive browser verification still outstanding.

Fixed a bug found by playtesting Squad Phase 1: requestBotPath silently beelined straight to the raw goal (ignoring walkability) whenever local A* found no route, which squad followers hit constantly chasing a moving formation point and walked themselves down slopes/into depressions alive, looking dead/stuck. Now retargets to the nearest walkable cell instead, only holding position if that also fails, with a pathRetryAt throttle so a genuinely stuck bot does not rebuild the nav grid every tick. Also fixed botTerrainWalkable checking loadedMap-only seaLevel for underwater rejection, leaving open procedural terrain with no water check at all; switched to the unified terrain.waterLevel.

Code-review follow-up on the terrain-trap fix: retargeting requestBotPath to the nearest walkable cell only covers an unreachable goal, not a bad bot position (e.g. pushBotsApart shoving a bot outside findPath start-snap radius), which would retry forever with the same failure regardless of goal. Added pathFailCount plus a bounded escape hatch (BOT_STUCK_ESCAPE_RETRIES = 6, about 3s of throttled failures) that bypasses the nav grid and steers straight for the bots own trusted spawnPos until a normal path succeeds again, so a stuck bot cannot stall permanently.

Fixed botSpawnSlot ignoring index on open terrain (no authored botSpawnPoints), which spawned every member of a squad on the same coincident point and left them visually clumped; fallback now spreads slots via a golden-angle spiral.

Fixed a second, distinct squad-clumping cause found by follow-up user question: retreat order sent every surviving squad member to the literal same squad.spawnPos coordinate instead of a formation-ring offset around it, so an already-active squad that took losses mid-fight would collapse onto one point just like the coincident-spawn bug. Non-leaders now keep their formation offset around the rally point during retreat.

Added a bot inspector debug tool (host/solo only) to diagnose continued live movement glitches directly: Alt+Click a bot in the scene or a table row to select it, arrow keys or Prev/Next buttons cycle, a live panel shows fsm state/position/speed/path-fail-count/squad/ammo, a yellow ring marker highlights the selection in 3D, and a per-row or panel Teleport button jumps the local player to any bot. GhostRenderer gained a playerGroups() accessor for the scene raycast pick.

Fixed a TDZ ReferenceError on hostBroadcastTick: botPlayers was declared with const far below where createHostSession wired getState in as a broadcast callback, so a fast local connection could fire the first tick during an intervening await and crash before botPlayers existed. Moved the declaration up next to mpGuestPlayers, which the same functions already depend on.

Fixed the documented third-person weapon-anchor scale bug: asRoot() in weapon-pose-controller.js now forwards decomposed scale, and composeRoot() in weapon-sequence.js multiplies weapon-anchor local positions by weaponRoot.scale (body/camera refs still skip it, since those offsets are already body-scale units) -- hands were missing the visible grip on weapons with non-unit thirdPersonHold scale (M1911 0.68, M24/Bren/RPG 2). Added scale coverage to test-weapon-sequence.mjs.

Added an http fallback (loadSfxSoundsHttp / loadSfxHttp) so SFX load automatically by fetching sfx/sound-map.json + assets/*.wav from the server, instead of requiring a manual File System Access folder pick every session; restoreSfxFolder() now falls back to it whenever no folder handle is stored or its permission is not silently granted. Root cause of a user report of no gunfire audio: the picker-only path silently no-ops play()/playAt() calls with zero console error when sfxBuffers is empty.

Synced m1911/five_seven/m24/cz_805_bren ADS aim (aimOffset/aimRotation), plus m24 and cz_805_bren scope/optics fields (magnification/scopeBlur/scopeRadius/scopeCenter) and cz_805_bren viewOffset/viewRotation/recoil/aimEyeForward, from the live-tuned values already sitting in a dev browser local session storage -- the committed file had stale pre-tuning defaults that only the hosted deploy (fresh origin, no override) was actually rendering; local looked correct because the browser override was masking the stale file.

Gated the pcw:weaponTuning localStorage save/restore behind a ?tune=1 query flag (TUNE_MODE) -- the mirror had no versioning, so a stale slider override in a browser would silently mask any future weapons.js default fix forever with no way to notice; only explicit ?tune=1 sessions now read/write it.

Add lifetime per-bot combat/movement stats (shots/hits/kills/deaths, time-in-state, distance traveled, stuck detection) to the bot inspector panel and a continuous botStatsLog CSV auto-uploaded to research/stats/bots-*.csv while recording.

Added a standalone menu-music audio hook to start-screen.js (plays the music_menu sound-map.json event during the role/map picker, since environment-audio.js is not constructed until after that screen resolves) and fixed sfx-browser.html hardcoding assets/<eventId>.wav for every assignment regardless of source format -- music tracks are almost never actually wav, so that bug would have silently broken any menu-music assignment.

Added a time-of-day driver (Component 3/C) to environment-viewer.html: static-imports sunPosition/moonPosition from solar-position.js and lerpHex from sky-field.js, adds a Time of day UI section above Lighting (master toggle + hour/latitude/day-of-year/moon-phase/speed + Play/Pause), and applyTimeOfDay() drives rig elevation/azimuth/sun color/sun intensity/ambient plus independent sun+moon sky dirs/visibility and moonLight from real solar geometry each frame while enabled, auto-enabling celestial opacity fade-in on first activation; the manual driver-off path is unchanged.

Fix ReferenceError: params is not defined thrown every animate() frame -- the time-of-day driver read params (todEnabled/todHour/todSpeed/todPlaying) which was a bare const scoped to the forest-loading promise callback, invisible to the top-level animate() function; forward-declared params at module scope like applyTimeOfDay/skyRef and changed the declaration to a plain assignment.

Stopped gameplay from falling back to the music_menu track when no music_game track is assigned -- desiredMusicEvent() now returns silence instead, since the menu track playing through actual gameplay was reported as unwanted, not a missing-fallback bug.
Authored mind/senses/body/environment procedural-creature design doc plus Vitruvian-bot diagram page
Rewrote creature-model doc and page in plain language per ISO 24495-1 (audience statement; short active sentences; lists; defined terms)
Removed invented square=capability/circle=environment metaphor; shapes now labeled as reach measurements and environment drawn as glyphs around the figure
